$comment: Tools-to-schema contract owned by tools/market-analytics. A pack that sets analytics.contract = market-analytics/v1 must provide these tables/columns (extra columns and tables are allowed). Logical types map to DuckDB/Arrow types in the checker. `for` lists the operations that need the table.

ticker_history.notes: Current ticker = row with effective_to IS NULL (asset_catalog artifact).

asset_relationships.notes: Required only when relationship_graph.mode is sparse_declared_peers.

$news_table.notes: Table name comes from analytics.news_table. alignment_session_number is derived today by the generator; v2 derives it in the release builder.

prediction.requires: pack.prediction with graph tables present as views in prediction.schema
